The image shows the receiver, pistol grip, magazine well with a inserted magazine, and a long barrel extending downwards. The texture appears somewhat metallic but with signs of digital smearing.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The magazine appears to melt into the body of the gun rather than sitting in a well. There is no clear mechanical separation.
The trigger guard is barely defined and seems to merge with the grip. The geometry is non-functional and physically unlikely.
The barrel lacks the consistent cylindrical reflection of metal; it has patchy, smeared highlights suggesting AI generation artifacts.
The rear of the weapon bulges unnaturally and lacks the sharp edges expected of machined metal parts.
